text:
kevin (oncall): heads up — saw a sudden spike in ephemeral-admin grants right after the 00:00 deploy. ~80 temp elevs, a few KMS binding retry failures, and some audit lines look missing. opening thread to triage; could be role-syncer race or deploy hook.

maria (seceng): can you paste the audit snippet or the affected principals? are these svcaccts or human elegs?

kevin (oncall): minimal snippet from audit-ingest (redacted):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-21T00:01:12Z","event":"iam.binding.create","principal":"svc-data-sync-ephemeral","role":"admin:project","target":"projects/prod","kms_key":"projects/prod/keyrings/app/cryptoKeys/ck1","request_id":"r-9f3"}
{"ts":"2026-03-21T00:01:12Z","event":"iam.binding.create","principal":"svc-data-sync-ephemeral","role":"admin:project","target":"projects/prod","request_id":"r-9f3-retry"}
# later there are revoke events but a chunk between 00:02-00:06 seems absent in logs
```

alex (infra): we ran the deploy hook that triggers role-syncer v2. it does rapid retries on failures. i'll check the deploy job logs for the same request_id. could be duplicate creates due to insufficient idempotency.

june (sre): oncall saw the access-review automation spike too — it flagged ~80 entries in the ephemeral bucket at 00:05. quick way to repro query: `SELECT principal, COUNT(*) FROM audit_events WHERE event IN ("iam.binding.create","iam.binding.delete") AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() GROUP BY principal;`

samuel (platform): ^ yup, role-syncer backoff logic doesn't persist a stable idempotency-key for the KMS binding flow. when KMS returns transient error we retry, which creates duplicate bindings in some clouds. i'll open a patch to add request-id persistence and backoff.

maria (seceng): two asks: 1) can we quickly revoke the duplicate bindings so least-privilege is restored? 2) we need to make sure the audit pipeline ingests the missing revoke events (00:02-00:06). without revokes the periodic access review will keep flagging them.

kevin (oncall): plan: alex/samuel revoke dup bindings for principals in the query; samuel will push hotfix for idempotency; audit team will reindex missing events. i'll run an emergency access-review dry-run after revokes to confirm. owners & ETAs?

alex (infra): revocation script in `ops/tools` — running a conservative pass now, will post runbook snippet once done. ETA 25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samuel (platform): patch branch `role-syncer/idempotency-fix` created, will prod-deploy in 40m after smoke. rolling back if anything weird. owner: samuel.

audit-bot: Access review report (ephemeral spike) ready: https://internal.reports/redwood/access-review/1764842000 — contains the principals list and missing-event ranges.

maria (seceng): postmortem action items (short): add idempotency keys to role-syncer, add a KMS binding hash to audit events, update access-review automation to correlate ephemeral create+delete windows before surfacing to reviewers, and add a pager for >50 ephemeral elevs in 5m.

june (sre): logging note — the ingestion pipeline dropped some events when the consumer restarted during a backfill window. i'll coordinate reindex + validate checksums.

kevin (oncall): thanks all. i ran the dry-run after revokes — counts back to baseline. leaving this open for postmortem notes. next steps: samuel to deploy patch, alex to confirm revoke completed and share script, june to reindex, maria to own postmortem doc. ack with ETA.

alex (infra): revoke complete, script: `ops/tools/revoke-duplicate-bindings --query 1764842000-spike` — pushed output to #eng-sre.

samuel (platform): prod patch deployed to canary, will monitor. ETA full rollout 40m. :white_check_mark:

maria (seceng): assigned postmortem, will draft today and share for comments. tagging response owners: @kevin (oncall) @alex (infra) @samuel (platform) @june (sre).

kevin (oncall): closing triage for now — feel free to ping if anything resurfaces. :thumbsup:
